metadata.title: NOAA/NCEI Southern California Coastal Relief Model v2 — Port of Los Angeles crop
metadata.source: NOAA/NCEI U.S. Coastal Relief Model, Southern California Version 2 (2012), 1 arc-second; regional merged topobathymetric DEM, not navigation data
metadata.horizontal_transform: Source NAD83 geographic coordinates are used directly in the local WGS84-style ENU frame; legacy NAD83/WGS84 datum difference is not resolved to a realization and is not survey-grade.
metadata.vertical_datum: Mean Sea Level (MSL), NOAA CRM Southern California Version 2; land elevations >= MSL masked as NoData; this is not MLLW or live tide.
metadata.reference_water_level_note: MSL reference plane from NOAA regional model; display reference only, not a real-time tide observation.
metadata.nodata_rule: NOAA FillValue (-9999) and land/on-mean-sea-level elevations (>=0 m) masked; only below-MSL cells rendered as seabed.
metadata.intended_use: Regional situational visualization only. Not for navigation, dredging, engineering, or safety-critical decisions; 1 arc-second regional grid does not resolve all harbor-channel details.
